prepared_phase_supply_annotations.note: THIS CELL'S OWN artifact, minted model-free under its own run id at the flip (item E16); --allow-output-change must never be passed.

purpose: SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-NX-R5-COMPOSED-DEV2000-ADDED-V1: Read in ONE chain: the replicate then the composed arm (campaign plan configs/campaign/slurp-native-stage3-nx-r5-composed-dev2000-added-v1.json). PRIMARY: official pooled SLU-F1 (slurp-slu-official), paired per utterance cluster (10,000 draws, seed 20260915), composed minus the sealed A2 arm (SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-COMP1B-DEV2000-ADDED-V1). GUARD: intent (scenario_action exact), same contrast. OFFSET o: replicate minus the sealed A2 in-chain A/A (SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-COMP1-AA-DEV2000-ADDED-V1), same metrics. THE BAR: 2.5 pp at n = 1,000 (instrument rule 3). NOMINATED iff the CI95 lower bound of (composed minus A2) on SLU-F1 is above |o| (beyond the replicate offset) AND the point estimate is at or above the 2.5 pp bar AND the intent guard shows no HARM; this is NOT expected (declared effect +0.07 pp) and would be a surprise to replicate before any use. NEUTRAL iff the CI95 lower bound of (composed minus A2) on SLU-F1 and on intent is at or above -2.5 pp (the preregistered harm margin) and the read is neither NOMINATED nor HARM: the composition keeps the full-graph accuracy within what a cross-flight read can see at about half the contacts -- still an efficiency result, never reported as a gain. HARM iff the CI95 upper bound of (composed minus A2) on SLU-F1 or on intent is below -|o| (a resolved loss beyond the flight offset, owner decision 25). A read whose lower bound is under -2.5 pp while neither HARM nor NOMINATED is UNRESOLVED (the design cannot rule out a margin loss) and is reported as such, not as NEUTRAL. Reported beside, CONTEXT ONLY and never the bar: composed minus the in-chain replicate (the whole composition against its same-chain base, intent and SLU-F1, with no offset correction needed); composed minus the sealed A2 in-chain A/A; the same contrasts with the v4g normaliser applied offline to the A2 and replicate columns so all columns are compared under v4g (isolating graph and supply from the normaliser); per-scenario tables in natural-mixture and equal-stratum weightings; the cost table. The verdict word is the coordinator's (owner decision 139).
quality_read_gate: No task-quality read before BOTH the composed arm and the replicate manifests are complete and sealed with one successful complete official slurp-slu-official score each, and the READ row is root countersigned.
